title: 第5章 炼脉九段第6章 废掉苏明
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
苏家。
嘭！
苏天愤怒的把手拍在桌子上。
“我让你去欺辱他一下，你倒好，直接把他逼死了，你让我怎么和三伯他们交代！”愤怒的苏天起身一脚将苏明踹飞，撞在墙上。
“咳。”苏明嘴中涌上一口鲜血，可又不敢吐出，只能又咽了下去。
白天被苏少卿打了一顿，现在又被苏天打，可想而知这伤势有多重了，不过苏明就算有万般怨言，也不敢在眼前的主面前露出半点不悦。
“大少爷息怒，是苏明办事不利，苏明认罚。”苏明跪在地上道。
“哼，认罚，你有几条命够罚的。”苏天走到苏明身前道：“自从我们吞并了三伯他们一家，三伯他们便于苏少卿他们交好，我也不得不收敛了点，现在你把苏少卿逼死了，三伯他们来借机找我爹的麻烦，顺势在剥离出去，你感觉我爹会放过我吗，到时候，我就需要一个替罪羊了。”
苏明登时冒出一身冷汗。
“少爷，我对你是忠心耿耿啊，我一切都是为您着想啊。”苏明害怕的将头磕在地上。
“哼，苏明，我给你一个将功赎罪的机会。”苏天道。
“大少爷吩咐，我苏明上刀山下火海，定不推辞。”
“丹药给你，伤好的差不多，回去把苏桃儿也杀了。”苏天扔给苏明一颗丹药。
“啊？”苏明有些不敢相信。
“让三伯他们，死无对证。”苏天回头看向苏明，眼中的冷意让苏明不寒而栗。
“是，少爷，我这就去。”苏明拿上丹药，忍着痛离去。
苏府内院门口。
苏明捂着胸口从中走出，刚迈出大门，便与两个随从撞了个满怀。
“你们两个狗东西，走路不看道啊！”苏明怒道。
那两个随从也吓了一跳，被苏明一声怒喝，才回过神来，反应道这是苏明，连忙向他报告。

“苏护卫，见鬼了，那个苏少卿，他……他活了！”随从甲慌张道。”
“什么，怎么可能，他经脉都断了，连呼吸都没了，怎么可能还活着，你们俩怕不是害怕的失心疯了吧。”苏明一脸鄙夷的看着二人。
“千真万确啊，苏护卫，我们俩亲眼看到他回了城南小院啊，我们……我们不敢造假啊！”随从乙道。
“这么说，他是有大机缘啊。”苏明眯着眼道：“大少爷有令，杀了苏少卿一家，明天你们和我再去一趟。”
“啊，苏护卫，我们……我们不敢。”俩随从害怕道。
“两个废物，他就是个残废，就算活了，他修为也能恢复吗，你们怕什么，有我在，你们还能死了不成。”苏明怒斥道。
“就是因为有你我们才怕会死啊。”随从甲嘟囔道。
“你说什么！”苏明瞪大眼睛看着随从甲。
“苏护卫，我们走，我们走。”随从乙连忙打着圆场。
“哼。”苏明一挥衣袖，离去。
“明天我们真去啊。”
“见势不对，跑呗，要死让他自己死去，真的是。”
content_en:
Su family.
Bang!
Su Tian slapped his hands on the table angrily.
"I asked you to humiliate him, but it would be better for you to just force him to death. How do you want me to explain to the third uncle and the others!" The angry Su Tian stood up and kicked Su Ming away and hit the wall.
"Cough." Su Ming had a mouthful of blood in his mouth, but he didn't dare to spit it out, so he could only swallow it again.
During the day, he was beaten by Su Shaoqing, and now he was beaten by Su Tian. You can imagine how serious the injury was. However, even if Su Ming had all kinds of complaints, he did not dare to show any displeasure in front of the master in front of him.
"Young master, please calm down. It's Su Ming's fault. Su Ming accepts the punishment." Su Ming knelt on the ground and said.
"Huh, accept the punishment. You have a few lives to deserve it." Su Tian walked up to Su Ming and said, "Since we annexed the third uncle and his family, the third uncle and his family have made it easier for Su Shaoqing and the others to be friends. I have to restrain myself a little. Now that you have forced Su Shaoqing to death, the third uncle and the others have come to take the opportunity to cause trouble for my father and are peeling off. Do you think my father will let me go? By then, I will need a scapegoat."
Su Ming suddenly broke into a cold sweat.
"Master, I am loyal to you. I do everything for your sake." Su Ming knocked his head to the ground in fear.
"Hmph, Su Ming, I'll give you a chance to atone for your sins." Su Tiandao.
"The eldest young master has commanded me, Su Ming, to go up to the mountain of swords and to the sea of fire, and I will never refuse."
"Here's the elixir for you. The injury is almost healed. Go back and kill Su Tao'er too." Su Tian threw a pill to Su Ming.
"Ah?" Su Ming couldn't believe it.
"Let Third Uncle and the others die without any evidence." Su Tian turned back to look at Su Ming, and the coldness in his eyes made Su Ming shudder.
"Yes, Master, I'll go right away." Su Ming took the elixir and left, enduring the pain.
The entrance to the inner courtyard of Su Mansion.
Su Ming walked out holding his chest. As soon as he stepped out of the door, he bumped into two followers.
"You two bitches don't look at the road when you're walking!" Su Ming said angrily.
The two followers were also startled. They came to their senses when Su Ming shouted angrily. They said it was Su Ming and reported to him quickly.
"Guard Su, what the hell, that Su Shaoqing, he...he's alive!" Attendant A said in a panic. "
"What, how is it possible? His meridians are broken and he has no breath. How can he still be alive? You two are probably crazy because of fear. "Su Ming looked at the two of them with disdain.
"It's absolutely true, Guard Su, we both saw him return to the small courtyard in the south of the city with our own eyes, we...we don't dare to lie! "Follow B."
"So, he has a great opportunity. Su Ming narrowed his eyes and said, "The eldest young master has an order to kill Su Shaoqing's family. You and I will go there again tomorrow." "
"Ah, Guard Su, we...we don't dare. "The two followers said in fear.
"Two wastes, he is a cripple. Even if he survives, can his cultivation be restored? What are you afraid of? With me here, can you still die? "Su Ming yelled angrily.
“It’s because of you that we are afraid of dying. "Follower A muttered.
"What did you say! "Su Ming looked at Follower A with wide eyes.
“Guard Su, let’s go, let’s go. " Entourage B quickly tried to smooth things over.
"Hmph. "Su Ming waved his sleeves and left.
"We're really going tomorrow. "
"When you see the situation is wrong, run away and let him die on his own, really. "
